title: Cause
subtitle: 「原因／導致」，究竟是在說一個原因、來源、誘因、根本原因，還是在說『使某事發生』？
description: 「原因／導致」，究竟是在說一個原因、來源、誘因、根本原因，還是在說『使某事發生』？

words.note: 當名詞 cause 指「為甚麼某件事發生」時，reason 是最常見的近義詞之一。reason 比 cause 更常出現在日常解釋、人的決定和事件原因中。
words.example: The main reason for the delay was a shortage of staff.
words.exampleZh: 延誤的主要原因是人手不足。

exercises.original: The main cause of the delay was a shortage of staff.
exercises.zh: 延誤的主要原因是人手不足。
exercises.upgrade: The main reason for the delay was a shortage of staff.

options.explanation: reason for the delay 是最自然的一般原因表達。
較強調來源位置／根源，不如 reason 直接。
偏直接觸發點，而 staff shortage 是一般原因。

exercises.original: There was no obvious cause for his sudden decision.
exercises.zh: 他突然作出決定，沒有明顯原因。
exercises.upgrade: There was no obvious reason for his sudden decision.

options.explanation: 人的決定『為甚麼』發生，通常用 reason 最自然。
可作其中一項因素，但此句問整體原因。
目的，不等於造成決定的原因。

exercises.original: One cause why customers left was the slow response time.
exercises.zh: 顧客離開的其中一個原因是回應太慢。
exercises.upgrade: One reason why customers left was the slow response time.

options.explanation: 亦可，但句型 reason why 更自然。
reason why customers left 是固定常見結構。

words.note: 當 cause 強調某個問題、影響、風險或現象從哪裡產生時，source 很自然。它聚焦『來源』而不只是抽象原因。
words.example: Investigators identified a faulty cable as the source of the fire.
words.exampleZh: 調查人員確認一條故障電纜是火警的來源。

exercises.original: Investigators found that a faulty cable was the cause of the fire.
exercises.zh: 調查人員發現故障電纜是火警來源。
exercises.upgrade: Investigators found that a faulty cable was the source of the fire.

options.explanation: faulty cable 是火警開始的具體來源，最貼切。
只表示其中因素，不一定是起火來源。

exercises.original: The team traced the cause of the leak to a cracked pipe.
exercises.zh: 團隊把洩漏源頭追查到一條破裂水管。
exercises.upgrade: The team traced the source of the leak to a cracked pipe.

options.explanation: 也接近，但 trace the source of a leak 更固定。
具體洩漏從哪裡來，最自然。
不能同樣突出物理來源。
洩漏本身可能是症狀，不是來源。

exercises.original: Contaminated water was identified as the cause of the infection.
exercises.zh: 受污染的水被確認為感染來源。
exercises.upgrade: Contaminated water was identified as the source of the infection.

options.explanation: 醫療／感染語境中 source of infection 是標準搭配。
較口語，沒有 infection source 的精準感。
可能有更深層衛生問題，水本身是感染來源。

words.note: 當 cause 指一個問題、現象或事件最初由哪裡開始時，origin 很接近。它比 source 更突出最初起點。
words.example: Researchers are still investigating the origin of the contamination.
words.exampleZh: 研究人員仍在調查污染的起因。

exercises.original: Scientists are investigating the cause of the contamination.
exercises.zh: 科學家正在調查污染的起因。
exercises.upgrade: Scientists are investigating the origin of the contamination.

options.explanation: 強調污染最初從何處／如何開始，最自然。
亦近，但 origin 更突出起點。

exercises.original: The exact cause of the rumour remains unclear.
exercises.zh: 謠言的確切起源仍不清楚。
exercises.upgrade: The exact origin of the rumour remains unclear.

options.explanation: 通常不是問為甚麼有人相信，而是謠言從哪裡開始。
origin of the rumour 精確表示最初來源。
偏某事促使謠言開始，不等於來源。

exercises.original: Researchers traced the cause of the outbreak to a single market.
exercises.zh: 研究人員把疫情起源追溯至一個市場。
exercises.upgrade: Researchers traced the origin of the outbreak to a single market.

options.explanation: trace the origin 與 outbreak 搭配自然，強調最初起點。

words.note: 當 cause 指一個直接令事件開始、反應發生或症狀出現的因素時，名詞 trigger 很精準。它常不是最深層根因，而是『觸發點』。
words.example: Stress can be a trigger for migraine attacks.
words.exampleZh: 壓力可以是偏頭痛發作的誘因。

exercises.original: The announcement caused a wave of complaints.
exercises.zh: 公告引發了一波投訴。
exercises.upgrade: The announcement triggered a wave of complaints.

options.explanation: 一項公告直接引發大量反應，最貼切。
也可，但 trigger 更有立即啟動感。

exercises.original: The smell caused memories of childhood to return.
exercises.zh: 這種氣味觸發了童年回憶。
exercises.upgrade: The smell triggered memories of childhood.

options.explanation: 感官刺激直接引起記憶，是典型心理用法。
語法可通，但不如 triggered 自然。

exercises.original: The report caused an immediate investigation.
exercises.zh: 報告立即觸發調查。
exercises.upgrade: The report triggered an immediate investigation.

options.explanation: immediate investigation 顯示直接啟動某程序。
也可，但 trigger 更符合 immediate。

words.note: 當 cause 特別指表面問題背後真正、最深層的原因時，root cause 很重要。常見於問題分析、工程、管理和政策。
words.example: The review found that poor maintenance was the root cause of the failure.
words.exampleZh: 檢討發現維修不足是故障的根本原因。

exercises.original: Poor maintenance was the underlying cause of the equipment failure.
exercises.zh: 維修不足是設備故障的根本原因。
exercises.upgrade: Poor maintenance was the root cause of the equipment failure.

options.explanation: 可能是即時觸發點，但 underlying 顯示要找深層原因。
underlying + failure 是 root cause analysis 的典型語境。

exercises.original: The investigation aimed to find the real cause behind repeated system crashes.
exercises.zh: 調查旨在找出系統反覆崩潰背後的真正根本原因。
exercises.upgrade: The investigation aimed to find the root cause behind repeated system crashes.

options.explanation: 可以，但未突出 deepest underlying cause。
repeated crashes + real cause behind 明確要求根因。
可能每次 crash 的觸發點不同。

exercises.original: Managers treated low morale as a symptom rather than the cause of the problem.
exercises.zh: 管理層把士氣低落視為症狀，而不是問題的根本原因。
exercises.upgrade: Managers treated low morale as a symptom rather than the root cause of the problem.

options.explanation: 可能是因素，但和 symptom 對比時 root cause 更精準。
表面症狀 vs 深層根因的對比非常清楚。
可接近但不如 root cause。
與 symptom 更接近結果端。

words.note: 當 cause 只是多個原因之一，而不是唯一原因時，factor 更準確。它常用於複雜結果由多項因素共同造成的語境。
words.example: Cost was one factor in the company's decision.
words.exampleZh: 成本是公司作出決定的其中一個因素。

exercises.original: Cost was one cause of the company's decision.
exercises.zh: 成本是公司作出決定的其中一個因素。
exercises.upgrade: Cost was one factor in the company's decision.

options.explanation: one factor in 明確表示多個原因之一。
可說 one reason，但 factor 更分析化。

exercises.original: Age is not the only cause affecting recovery time.
exercises.zh: 年齡並非影響康復時間的唯一因素。
exercises.upgrade: Age is not the only factor affecting recovery time.

options.explanation: not the only + affecting 表示多因素情況。
較少用於統計變量式語境。

exercises.original: Several causes contributed to the decline in sales.
exercises.zh: 多個因素共同導致銷售下降。
exercises.upgrade: Several factors contributed to the decline in sales.

options.explanation: contributed to 本身已表示多項因素共同作用。
也可，但分析語境 factor 更自然。
會暗示多個直接觸發點。

words.note: 動詞 cause 的高價值近義表達。通常表示某個行動、改變或事件使另一結果發生，語氣中性至稍正式。
words.example: The reforms brought about major changes in the industry.
words.exampleZh: 改革令業界出現重大變化。

exercises.original: The reforms caused major changes in the industry.
exercises.zh: 改革令業界出現重大變化。
exercises.upgrade: The reforms brought about major changes in the industry.

options.explanation: 表示某政策／改革造成變化，最自然。
方向相反：changes resulted from reforms。

exercises.original: New technology caused a sharp reduction in processing time.
exercises.zh: 新技術令處理時間大幅縮短。
exercises.upgrade: New technology brought about a sharp reduction in processing time.

options.explanation: 技術變化造成 reduction，語法和語義都準確。

exercises.original: The agreement caused a lasting improvement in relations.
exercises.zh: 協議令關係得到持久改善。
exercises.upgrade: The agreement brought about a lasting improvement in relations.

options.explanation: 協議使改善發生，是典型搭配。

words.note: 非常常用的 cause 動詞近義詞。比 cause 更突出從一個情況逐步導向另一結果，尤其適合因果鏈。
words.example: Poor drainage can lead to flooding.
words.exampleZh: 排水不良可以導致水浸。

exercises.original: Poor drainage can cause flooding.
exercises.zh: 排水不良可以導致水浸。
exercises.upgrade: Poor drainage can lead to flooding.

options.explanation: 從原因自然導向結果，最常見因果表達。
方向相反：flooding results from poor drainage。
可時間上跟隨但不保證因果。

exercises.original: A lack of sleep can cause poor concentration.
exercises.zh: 睡眠不足可以導致注意力下降。
exercises.upgrade: A lack of sleep can lead to poor concentration.

options.explanation: 也很接近，但題目目標 lead to 更通用自然。
睡眠不足→注意力差，是自然因果鏈。

exercises.original: Small errors can cause serious problems later.
exercises.zh: 小錯誤日後可以導致嚴重問題。
exercises.upgrade: Small errors can lead to serious problems later.

options.explanation: later 顯示由小錯誤逐步導向後果。
較像直接突然觸發，未必有 later 的過程感。

words.note: 和 lead to 非常接近，但稍正式、結果導向更強。常見於報告、研究、技術與新聞寫作。
words.example: The error resulted in a two-hour delay.
words.exampleZh: 這個錯誤導致兩小時延誤。

exercises.original: The error caused a two-hour delay.
exercises.zh: 這個錯誤導致兩小時延誤。
exercises.upgrade: The error resulted in a two-hour delay.

options.explanation: 正式、結果導向，最適合 error → delay。

exercises.original: The storm caused extensive damage to the coast.
exercises.zh: 暴風雨導致沿岸廣泛損毀。
exercises.upgrade: The storm resulted in extensive damage to the coast.

options.explanation: storm 造成 damage，是標準因果搭配。
damage 才會 result from storm。

exercises.original: A software bug caused several transactions to fail.
exercises.zh: 軟件錯誤導致數宗交易失敗。
exercises.upgrade: A software bug resulted in several transactions failing.

options.explanation: 技術報告常用，精確描述 bug 的後果。

words.note: 較正式的 cause 近義片語，常用於問題、爭議、風險、疑問或新情況的產生。
words.example: The new rule gave rise to several legal questions.
words.exampleZh: 新規則引起了數個法律問題。

exercises.original: The new rule caused several legal questions.
exercises.zh: 新規則引起數個法律問題。
exercises.upgrade: The new rule gave rise to several legal questions.

options.explanation: questions / concerns / disputes 是這個片語的典型搭配。

exercises.original: Rapid growth caused concerns about housing supply.
exercises.zh: 快速增長引起住房供應方面的憂慮。
exercises.upgrade: Rapid growth gave rise to concerns about housing supply.

options.explanation: give rise to concerns 是正式高頻搭配。

exercises.original: The ambiguity caused a dispute between the two parties.
exercises.zh: 含糊之處引起雙方爭議。
exercises.upgrade: The ambiguity gave rise to a dispute between the two parties.

options.explanation: 法律／正式語境中表示產生 dispute，非常自然。

words.note: 當 cause 表示某個過程、政策、物質或行動產生可觀察的結果、效果或變化時，produce 很自然。
words.example: The treatment produced a noticeable improvement.

exercises.original: The treatment caused a noticeable improvement.
exercises.zh: 治療產生了明顯改善。
exercises.upgrade: The treatment produced a noticeable improvement.

options.explanation: 治療產生 measurable improvement，是典型搭配。

exercises.original: The chemical reaction caused a large amount of heat.
exercises.zh: 化學反應產生大量熱力。
exercises.upgrade: The chemical reaction produced a large amount of heat.

options.explanation: 也很自然，但 produce 更一般地表示產出結果。
化學反應產生 heat，標準用法。

exercises.original: The policy caused better results than expected.
exercises.zh: 政策產生了比預期更好的結果。
exercises.upgrade: The policy produced better results than expected.

options.explanation: produce results 是非常自然的搭配。

words.note: 作動詞時，trigger 表示直接令某反應、事件、症狀或連鎖過程開始。比一般 cause 更有『突然啟動』意味。
words.example: The announcement triggered a wave of complaints.
words.exampleZh: 這項公告引發了一波投訴。

exercises.original: The announcement caused a wave of complaints.
exercises.zh: 公告引發了一波投訴。
exercises.upgrade: The announcement triggered a wave of complaints.

options.explanation: 公告直接令投訴潮開始，最符合『直接觸發』。
也可表示產生，但即時啟動感較弱。

exercises.original: The smell caused memories of childhood to return.
exercises.zh: 這種氣味觸發了童年回憶。
exercises.upgrade: The smell triggered memories of childhood.

options.explanation: 感官刺激引發記憶是典型心理語境。
可以表示產生，但不如 trigger 自然。

exercises.original: The report caused an immediate investigation.
exercises.zh: 報告立即觸發調查。
exercises.upgrade: The report triggered an immediate investigation.

options.explanation: immediate investigation 表示直接啟動程序。
也可，但 immediate 更支持 trigger。

words.note: 當 cause 的結果是情緒、反應、爭議、衝突或強烈回應時，provoke 很精準。它常帶較強烈或負面的語氣。
words.exampleZh: 這項決定激起廣泛憤怒。

exercises.original: The decision caused widespread anger.
exercises.zh: 這項決定激起廣泛憤怒。
exercises.upgrade: The decision provoked widespread anger.

options.explanation: 強烈情緒反應 anger 是 provoke 的典型受詞。
可產生 interest/revenue 等，但怒氣反應用 provoke 更精準。

exercises.original: His comments caused a strong reaction from the audience.
exercises.zh: 他的評論引起觀眾強烈反應。
exercises.upgrade: His comments provoked a strong reaction from the audience.

options.explanation: 亦可，但 provoke a reaction 尤其適合言論引起強烈回應。

exercises.original: The article caused fierce criticism online.
exercises.zh: 文章在網上招致猛烈批評。
exercises.upgrade: The article provoked fierce criticism online.

options.explanation: provoke criticism 是高頻新聞搭配。
較機械，不如 provoke 符合強烈社會反應。

words.note: 當 cause 表示產生需求、收入、興趣、熱量、數據、關注或其他可累積結果時，generate 很常用。它比 cause 更偏『產出』。
words.example: The campaign generated significant public interest.
words.exampleZh: 這場活動引起了大量公眾興趣。

exercises.original: The campaign caused significant public interest.
exercises.zh: 這場活動引起大量公眾興趣。
exercises.upgrade: The campaign generated significant public interest.

options.explanation: generate interest 是商業／媒體常見搭配，表示產生可累積關注。
通常搭配較強烈／負面反應。

exercises.original: The new service caused additional revenue for the company.
exercises.zh: 新服務為公司產生額外收入。
exercises.upgrade: The new service generated additional revenue for the company.

options.explanation: 也可，但 generate revenue 是固定高頻商業搭配。
收入是典型可產出結果，最自然。

exercises.original: The announcement caused strong demand for tickets.
exercises.zh: 公告引發了門票的強勁需求。
exercises.upgrade: The announcement generated strong demand for tickets.

options.explanation: generate demand 是商業高頻搭配。

falseSynonyms.zh: reason 常回答「為甚麼」。 cause 更強調實際造成結果的因素。 很多語境可重疊，但不是永遠互換。
falseSynonyms.point: the reason for his decision the cause of the accident

falseSynonyms.zh: source 強調某問題／影響從哪裡來。 它通常比一般 cause 更具「來源點」概念。
falseSynonyms.point: source of infection source of the leak

falseSynonyms.zh: trigger 通常是直接觸發點。 它未必是最深層原因。
falseSynonyms.point: stress = trigger underlying neurological condition = possible deeper cause

falseSynonyms.zh: root cause 是最深層、真正需要處理的根因。 表面上最接近事件的 trigger 未必是 root cause。
factor 通常表示多個影響因素之一。 所以它比單一、決定性的 cause 更弱。
方向相反： cause 是原因端；result 是後果端。
lead to 很常見，但通常需要：
result in = 導致。 result from = 由……造成。 方向不要混淆：
falseSynonyms.point: The error resulted in a delay. The delay resulted from the error.
